verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop processor, not a hosted service, so choosing a storage region or data residency is not an axis this kind of product could offer. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any data-residency capability; mentions of AI running locally describe on-device inference, not region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
